Dahi Paneer Kebab 🥣🌱

Serves: 1
~475 kcal | ~37 g protein

Ingredients
Low-fat paneer - 70 g
Carrot - 1 (grated)
Onion - ½ (finely chopped)
Capsicum - ¼ cup (chopped)
Beans - ¼ cup (chopped)
Ginger-garlic paste - ½ tbsp
Salt - to taste
Red chilli powder - 1 tsp
Hung curd/Greek yogurt - 200 g
Roasted besan - 2 tbsp
Oats - 20 g
Coriander leaves - 1 cup
Mint leaves - ½ cup
Cashew - 4 (soaked)
Garlic - 2 cloves
Ginger - ½ inch
Lemon juice - 1 lemon
Red chilli powder - 1 tsp

Method
1. In a bowl, add crumbled paneer, grated carrot, onion, capsicum, beans and ginger-garlic paste.
2. Add hung curd/Greek yogurt, roasted besan, oats, salt and red chilli powder. Mix everything well.
3. Shape the mixture into kebabs.
4. Cook the kebabs on a pan or air fry until golden brown and cooked through.
5. For the dressing, blend coriander leaves, mint leaves, soaked cashews, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, salt and red chilli powder until smooth.
6. Serve the dahi paneer kebabs hot with the coriander-mint dressing. 🌿

Chilli flakes - ½ tsp
Mixed herbs - ½ tsp
Tomato - 2

Coriander leaves - 10 g
Hung curd - 100 g
Black salt - to taste
Green chilli - 2
